commands.doctor: node apps/server/dist/bin.mjs doctor --help (prints the doctor help; --dry-run needs a pre-existing database, so the smoke uses --help)

server.note: The default `t3` command starts the WebSocket server and loads AnalyticsService; the adapter never invokes it.
server.state: T3CODE_HOME scratch dir (never the live ~/.t3 userdata)

telemetry.default: ON — AnalyticsService (apps/server/src/telemetry/AnalyticsService.ts) sends PostHog batches to https://ingest.t3.codes with a hardcoded default key unless disabled

env_switches.T3CODE_POSTHOG_HOST: emptied by the adapter (defense in depth)
env_switches.T3CODE_POSTHOG_KEY: emptied by the adapter (defense in depth)
env_switches.T3CODE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: false — forced by the adapter; gates record AND sendBatch entirely

telemetry.network: talk-only commands only (--help, --version, help, doctor --help); the server is never started, so AnalyticsService is never loaded; --help also verified inside `unshare -n` when available
telemetry.sdk: none (no posthog-js / sentry / segment / mixpanel / amplitude in any manifest); the sender is hand-rolled HTTP in AnalyticsService.ts
